title: Would you survive your car sinking in water? #shorts

script: Your car goes off the road and hits the water, and it starts to sink. Panic tells you to call for help or wait, and that's what drowns people. Here's what actually works, remembered as a simple rule: seatbelts, windows, out, children first. Undo your seatbelt immediately. Do not open the door, the water pressure outside makes it nearly impossible and floods you faster.
